biggest_catch: The bonus is paid in miles, not cash — its guaranteed cash value is $200 only if you redeem for cash (statement credit/deposit/check at 1¢/mile per Truist's official FAQ, $25 minimum redemption); travel redemptions vary.
catches: Never spend extra solely to chase the $1,500 threshold — only use spending you already planned.
The card has no annual fee, which is good, but the miles have a $25 minimum for cash redemption and are worth 1¢ each for cash — do not assume inflated travel value.
Applying involves a hard credit inquiry when Truist processes the application.
Carrying a balance at 18.74%–27.74% variable APR can erase the bonus many times over — pay in full every month.
Cash advances, balance transfers, fees, gift cards, and quasi-cash (wire transfers, crypto, money orders, lottery, gambling) do not count toward the $1,500 threshold.
Rewards expire 5 years after issuance; the account must be open and in good standing or unredeemed miles can be forfeited.

steps: Open the official Truist page https://www.truist.com/credit-cards and choose the Enjoy Travel card application — do not apply from an affiliate link with different terms.
Complete the application with your identity, income, and SSN/ITIN; Truist runs a hard credit inquiry when you apply.
If approved, spend $1,500 on purchases you were already planning within the first 90 days of account opening.
Pay the balance in full every month — carrying a balance at 18.74%–27.74% variable APR destroys the bonus.
After the spend threshold is met, the 20,000 bonus miles post to your rewards account; redeem for cash (statement credit, deposit, or check) at 1¢ per mile = $200 (minimum $25 per cash redemption).
